correctness.rationale: For y^2=x^5+x+t in characteristic 7 the discriminant is 3(t^4-1); expansion of f^3 gives Cartier matrix [[6t,3t^2],[0,0]], so all smooth fibers are nonordinary, 7-rank is one for t !=0 and superspecial at t=0. Four distinct Morse critical values supply an A4 symplectic vanishing-cycle chain; their four mod-3 transvections generate the entire order-51840 Sp4(F3), independently re-enumerated by a fresh 4x4 matrix BFS. As 51840 is prime to 7, prime-to-7 tame specialization of the smooth marked base retains this geometric quotient. This depends on genuine Picard-Lefschetz and tame specialization theorems, not solely the finite group calculation. Full 3-adic monodromy is not established.
